think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range/order. 2) Check official PostgreSQL semantics for any sentinel values (e.g., 0, -1) that switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/ignore). 3) Determine whether those sentinel values break the usual numeric interpretation (i.e., not just ‘smaller’ but ‘different behavior’). 4) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
